label: Some bearer of an occurring thought has a concrete ground-ancestor that…, by Constructive-proof
meaning: Necessary concrete ground-ancestor of the Cogito's bearer (#564). Apply COGITO-ANCESTRY-ROOT-FORK and close its second horn with the thinker-local anti-brute-root principle: a contingent root in the thinker's ancestry would have an actual concrete ground, contradicting rootness. The conclusion is a concrete ground-ancestor of some bearer of an occurring thought that exists at w and at every world accessible from w; it implies NecessaryConcreteAt (vocabulary lemma necessaryConcreteAt_of_ancestor, not a registered result). Compared with necessaryConcreteOfGroundedContingents and #487's closed PR #528, the two global premises (whole-carrier well-foundedness; every actual contingent concretum grounded) are replaced by thinker-local premises that are strictly weaker (COGITO-ANCESTRY-CONTROLS), at the cost of the four open Cogito premises. No premise says the thinker is contingent; in the strictness model the thinker is not contingent and exists at every accessible world. Each non-logical premise is needed (COGITO-ANCESTRY-CONTROLS). All six non-logical premises remain open; no root path is reached, since no root-path premise uses world-indexed de re necessity. Necessity is accessibility-relative (not all-world), and nothing about uniqueness, underivedness, simplicity, intellect, personality or God follows.
